  "thinking": "Only about 12 seconds are left and Grace is still re-seating the domino past the nose, so no push should happen on anyone's word but hers. My hands are empty and I'd only disturb live joints, so I'll back the no-push rule and stay put.",
  "say": "Sofia here: agreed, nobody pushes until Grace calls the nose clear and Priya calls START joined. I'm keeping my hands off the tail junction, Tom. Tell me once it's standing and I'll look at the lower tail from there.",

  "do": "stop",
  "notes": "Fish faces left, tail on the right, START at the top of the tail. Nose (Grace): re-seating the domino past it; no push until she calls it clear. Tail join (Maya): gap closed. Top fin (Priya): needs two dominoes under START; she'll call when done. Dorsal fin (stroke 6, Sam): laid. Belly (stroke 2) and bottom fin end at the tail junction (23, 12.5): Tom fixing now. Lower tail still pale; jammed spot (25.5, 13.5) still open. Priya whispered to Hana and Maya; I missed it, so ask her to repeat if there's time. Push only when: nose clear (Grace), START joined (Priya), tail junction closed (Tom), lower tail connected. I'm holding hands idle and will recheck the lower tail once Tom says it's standing."
